statement: ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∀ a : ℕ → ℝ, Tendsto a atTop (𝓝[≠] (0 : ℝ)) → ∀ᶠ k in atTop, 0 < |a k| ∧ |a k| < η
proof:
intro η hη a ha
have ha₀ : Tendsto a atTop (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := (tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mp ha).1
have habs : Tendsto (fun k => |a k|) atTop (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := by simpa only [abs_zero] using ha₀.abs
have hsmall : ∀ᶠ k in atTop, |a k| < η := habs.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hη)
filter_upwards [(tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mp ha).2, hsmall] with k hk hkη
exact ⟨abs_pos.mpr hk, hkη⟩

checked : ∀ (n m : ℕ) (u : WaveMap.X n × ℝ → WaveMap.V m) (q : WaveMap.V m),
  1 ≤ n ∧ 1 ≤ m →
    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) u (WaveMap.domain n) →
      (∀ (t : ℝ), 0 < t → ∃ C R, WaveMap.supportGeometry u q t C R ∧ WaveMap.supportSections u t C R) ∧
          (∀ (t : ℝ), 0 < t → Integrable (fun x => WaveMap.density u (x, t)) volume) ∧
            ContinuousOn (WaveMap.density u) (WaveMap.domain n) ∧ ContinuousOn (WaveMap.densityT u) (WaveMap.domain n) →
        (∀ (x : WaveMap.X n) (t : ℝ),
            0 < t →
              HasDerivAt (fun r => WaveMap.density u (x, r)) (WaveMap.densityT u (x, t)) t ∧
                WaveMap.densityT u (x, t) =
                  2 * WaveMap.timeProduct u (x, t) + 2 * ∑ j, WaveMap.mixedProduct u j (x, t)) →
          (∀ (t : ℝ),
              0 < t →
                ∃ η B R,
                  0 < η ∧
                    0 ≤ B ∧
                      0 < R ∧
                        η < t ∧
                          Integrable ((WaveMap.box n R).indicator fun x => B) volume ∧
                            ∀ (h : ℝ),
                              0 < |h| →
                                |h| < η →
                                  ∀ (x : WaveMap.X n),
                                    |WaveMap.quotient u t h x| ≤ (WaveMap.box n R).indicator (fun x => B) x) →
            ∀ (η : ℝ), 0 < η → ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ), Tendsto a atTop (𝓝[≠] 0) → ∀ᶠ (k : ℕ) in atTop, 0 < |a k| ∧ |a k| < η
